name: Stable Diffusion 3.5
description: A text-to-image model that generates high-resolution images with fine details. It supports various artistic styles and produces diverse outputs from the same prompt.

action.description: A text-to-image model that generates high-resolution images with fine details. It supports various artistic styles and produces diverse outputs from the same prompt.
action.name: stability-ai/stable-diffusion-3.5-large

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of your output image. This value is ignored if you are using an input image.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

cfg.description: The guidance scale tells the model how similar the output should be to the prompt.
cfg.title: Cfg

image.description: Input image for image to image mode. The aspect ratio of your output will match this image.
image.title: Image

output_quality.description: Quality of the output images, from 0 to 100. 100 is best quality, 0 is lowest quality.
output_quality.title: Output Quality

prompt_strength.description: Prompt strength (or denoising strength) when using image to image. 1.0 corresponds to full destruction of information in image.
prompt_strength.title: Prompt Strength

seed.description: Seed value for random number generator. Uncheck for reproducible results.
seed.title: Seed

steps.description: Number of steps to run the sampler for.
steps.title: Steps
